experiment: G3 flip rate at the margin

config.batching: insertion order, batch_size inputs per batch
config.tie_convention: exact-k: each scoring of a pool selects exactly k candidates; members are ordered by score, and equal scores by a seeded key sha256(seed|pool_id|resume_id) that is identical in the male-form and female-form scorings of a comparison; in-top-k iff ordinal rank <= k. Mean ranks use average ranks. The earlier average-rank rule is reported per model under legacy_average_rank_rule.

names.source: name table names_gender.csv (pct_female column, percent scale)

provenance.deid_module: code/deid_transforms.py (not used by G3; the two forms are gender counterfactuals, not de-identified text)

legacy_average_rank_rule.rule: in top-k iff average rank <= k (can select != k at a tied cutoff)
